faults.title: Handbrake not holding on slopes
faults.description: Some first-generation Mokka owners have reported a handbrake that does not hold the car securely on a steep incline. Have the parking-brake mechanism checked and repaired if it slips.

faults.title: Adaptive-headlamp faults
faults.description: The Mokka's adaptive headlights can develop problems, particularly on earlier cars. Test their movement and warning lights and have the fault diagnosed before replacing a lamp unit.
